metadata.title: Localizing a Dirac operator via $J$-holomorphic curves
metadata.abstract: Let $(M,J)$ be a compact almost hermitian $4$-manifold with a smooth embedded $J$-holomorphic curve $C$ representing the canonical class. Motivated by the symplectic Bogomolov--Miyaoka--Yau conjecture, we choose a twisted spin$^{\text{c}}$ Dirac operator ${\mathcal D}$ on $M$ satisfying $$ \operatorname{ind}{\mathcal D}=3c_2(M)-c_1^2(M). $$ We then use the curve $C$ to construct a complex-linear perturbation ${\mathcal A}$ of ${\mathcal D}$ whose singular set is $Z_α\sqcup C$, where $Z_α=α^{-1}(0)$ for a transverse section $α$ of $Λ^{1,0}M$ nonvanishing on $C$. Applying Maridakis' index localization theorem, we express $\operatorname{ind}{\mathcal D}$ as the sum of localized contributions: $3c_2(M)$ from $Z_α$ and $-c_1^2(M)$ from $C$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 利用代表典范类的嵌入 J 全纯曲线扰动 Dirac 算子并局部化指数 3c2-c1²。
analysis.breakthrough: 把特征数分解为离散零点与曲线贡献。
analysis.limitations: 局部化恒等式本身不证明辛 BMY 不等式。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
analysis.aiEvidence: AI disclosure 披露 GPT 协助局部变形构造，建议附录中的同伦群同构和相关映射。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.07177v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
analysis.priorityReason: 分析拓扑联系清楚，但离动机猜想仍有距离。
